name: What Questions Should You Ask Before Hiring a Contractor?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring a contractor for kitchen, bath, or ADU work in Los Angeles County?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring a contractor for kitchen, bath, or ADU work in Los Angeles County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor, homeowners should focus on experience, process, and accountability rather than just the bid total. Important questions include whether the contractor has completed similar ADUs, kitchen remodels, and bathroom renovations in Los Angeles County, how permits are handled, who will manage the site, and how communication works during the job. It is also smart to ask how change orders are priced, what warranty is provided, and how unforeseen conditions are documented. Recent local references and portfolio examples are valuable because they show whether the contractor can handle real-world conditions similar to your property. A strong contractor should answer clearly and explain the plan without pressure or vague promises. That level of transparency is often a better indicator of project success than the lowest price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about licensing, insurance, similar project experience, permit handling, timeline, payment schedule, change orders, warranty coverage, and who will supervise the job daily. You should also ask to see recent local projects and confirm how the contractor handles delays and unexpected conditions. Clear answers help you compare professionalism, not just price.
